_meta.status: EMPTY — SURVEYED, NOT IN HOLDINGS. Every holding was surveyed 2026-10-21 (see survey doc): Tekken 7 customization part meshes exist in none of them. parts[] stays empty until the acquisition route in the survey doc lands real meshes; parts then drop in additively in this exact shape. named_gaps[] below is documentation only — it is NOT part of parts[], the runtime never resolves it, and resolveProfileParts() reports a named-gap part_id as 'unresolved' (never silently dropped) until the real part lands in parts[].
_meta.suite_slot_mapping: T7 slot -> suite_slot: HEAD->head, HAIR->hair, FULL_HEAD->full_head, HAIR_ACC->hair_acc, GLA->glasses, FACE->face, FACE_HAIR->face_hair, MAKE_UP->make_up (texture_part), UPPER->upper_body, FULL_BODY->full_body, LOWER->lower_body, UPPER_ACC->upper_acc, LOWER_ACC->lower_acc, EXTRA->extra, Effects->effect, Aura->aura. Scope: in-pak mesh folder 'cmn' = generic (PlayerCus 0); a character-abbreviation folder = that character's parts (charId per tekken7-slot-catalog.json).
